question: Where is restaurant located within 110 kilometers in the forward direction toward the Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA from Hungry Valley SVRA, Gorman, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hungry Valley SVRA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Last House on Mulholland%' LIMIT 1 ), azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT sp.geometry AS start_geom, ep.geometry AS end_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)) AS target_azimuth FROM start_point AS sp, end_point AS ep ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, azimuth_calc AS ac WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ac.start_geom::geography, 110000) -- 110 kilometers AND ABS( (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ac.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ac.target_azimuth + 180 + 360) % 360 - 180 ) <= 45; -- within +/- 45 degrees of the target azimuth
